title: Taylor hospitalized with injuries from ranch phenomena

tellings.quote: He had to go to the hospital because of injuries and he's had things happen that have followed him.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a man named Travis Taylor, who has worked there, had to go to the hospital because of injuries. According to the owner, things have also happened to Taylor that have "followed him" after leaving the ranch, which would mean whatever is at the ranch can reach beyond it.
